If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overreaction.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to compensate for bearish bias.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 in the last 3 days, add 1–2% to forecast for mid horizon (8–15 days) to capture momentum.  
If sentiment is 0.00 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1–2% for late horizon (16–30 days) to reflect lack of conviction.  
If sentiment is 0.33 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.0% for mid horizon to avoid overcorrection.  
If sentiment is 0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 0.5–1.0% for late horizon to offset pessimism.
